propositions: ProductionBatchRunner.run receives req.usd_budget as a per-plan cost cap override but cannot apply it because run_pass1 calls shed_to_budget which computes the cap internally with no injection point
The existing REBAR_PLAN_REVIEW_BUDGET env var is read as a base and then centrality-scaled, making it unsuitable as a true cap override
An optional cap_override parameter must thread through ProductionBatchRunner.run → run_pass1 → shed_to_budget, used verbatim without centrality scaling, with None selecting the computed cap
cap_override=0.0 must be honourable as a real cap rather than treated as absent, requiring selection on 'is None' rather than falsiness
coverage[budget] must gain a cap_source field recording 'override' or 'computed' to track which cap governed each run
The plan-review gate YAML does not set usd_budget on its finders batch, so live gate behaviour remains unchanged until a separate cost-policy decision sets one
